marks.gloss_en: and the ba'al happikim
his digits ride one upon another
extra [digits] on his hands and feet, six and six -- twenty-four: R' Yehuda deems fit
'his heel protrudes behind' -- R' Elazar: his calf comes out in the middle of his foot
the baraita: 'broken-footed' -- I have only a broken leg
והאמרת כשר! -- but the mishna said [attached and cut] is fit
אלא ולא חתכן -- the baraita speaks of where he did not cut them (= p_stam_velo_chatachan)
the baraita [as first cited]: fingers configured above, or attached above the joint [are disqualified -- from where?]
the baraita: 'broken-handed' -- I have only a broken hand
הכי נמי מסתברא, דאי לא תימא הכי, מאתים וארבעים ושמונה היכי משכחת לה? לא באיש ולא באשה -- otherwise the count of 248 fits neither a man nor a woman
ובאיש ליכא? והכתיב: צירים אחזוני כצירי יולדה (Isa 21:3)! -- a man too is said to have tzirim
צירי בשר -- hinges of flesh (= p_tzirei_basar)
והכתיב: אדני במראה נהפכו צירי (Dan 10:16)!
הכא נמי צירי בשר -- here too hinges of flesh (= p_tzirei_basar)
[the hinges the verses ascribe to a man are] hinges of flesh
מה נפשך? אי אבר הוא — באהל נמי תטמא, ואי לאו אבר הוא — במגע ובמשא נמי לא ליטמי! -- if it is a limb let it defile in a tent too; if not, let it not defile by contact and carrying either
R' Yochanan: they made their words [on the uncounted digit] like words of prophecy
משום עצם כשעורה נגעו בה -- it is treated as a barley-grain bone, which defiles by contact and carrying and not in a tent (= p_huna_etzem_kiseora, in Rav Acha breih deRav Ika's name)
Rav Huna bar Manoach in the name of Rav Acha breih deRav Ika: they dealt with it as a bone the size of a barley grain
גזירה שאינה נספרת אטו נספרת -- a decree on account of the counted digit (= p_pappa_gezeira; itself challenged at 45a.13 and defended at 45a.14)
אי הכי, שאינה נספרת באהל נמי תטמא! -- if it is a decree on account of the counted digit, let the uncounted one defile in a tent as well
Rav Pappa: a decree -- the uncounted digit on account of the counted one
עבדו רבנן היכירא, כי היכי דלא לישרפו עלייהו תרומה וקדשים (= p_heikera)
the Rabbis made a distinguishing mark, so that teruma and consecrated food not be burned on their account
לרבי עקיבא קשיא דתלמידי רבי ישמעאל! -- the students found 252, which leaves no room for a key
דלמא איידי דזוטר אתמוחי מתמח -- perhaps, being small, it dissolved [in the boiling]
R' Akiva: as a house has a key, so a woman has a key
an extra digit that has a bone and no nail imparts impurity by contact
Rav: an extra digit that has a bone and no nail imparts impurity by contact
the mishna (Oholot 2:1): most of the frame or most of the number [of bones] of a corpse, though there is not a quarter-kav in it, are impure
the baraita: one lacking, who has only two hundred, and one with extra, who has two hundred and eighty-one -- all count toward the number of one hundred and twenty-five
R' Yishmael's students boiled a harlot condemned to burning by the king, examined, and found in her two hundred and fifty-two
R' Elazar: as a house has hinges, so a woman has hinges
Rav: and all of them [the woman's additional limbs] do not impart impurity in a tent
R' Yochanan: and that is so [the disqualification] only where it is counted along the back of the hand
